home.subtitle: Visual artist exploring the boundaries between abstraction and emotion
home.bio: Argentine visual artist and educator from Mar del Plata, focused on contemporary realism, with works of strong symbolic, psychological and social content. His production is grounded in the mastery of classical oil painting techniques, applied to a narrative and current perspective. He has a sustained career in exhibitions, salons and national competitions, with prizes and recognitions obtained.
